title: Opportunity List
prompt: List page showing all job opportunities as cards. Same JobPulse identity (indigo accent, near-black logo, dot-grid background, shadow-xs cards with rounded-xl, leading-dot status indicators, NO emoji anywhere). Top: page title in Chinese "mian shi ji hui" and a primary indigo-700 "+ xin jian" button on the right. Below the title: a search input (full width) plus a horizontal chip-group filter for status (quan bu / jin xing zhong / yi Offer / yi jie shou / wei tong guo / wo yi che hui) with the active chip in indigo-700 bg-white text. The list is a vertical stack of opportunity cards using the same card style as the Dashboard. Each card shows: company + position as the card title in font-semibold, then a single metadata line: salary (e.g. 10K-12K*13), city, work hours, and "shuang xiu" if applicable. Right side: small leading-dot status indicator (dot plus text). On hover: card border becomes indigo-700, shadow-sm. Empty state: a small geometric illustration (a circle plus a square outline in indigo-200) with text "hai mei you mian shi ji hui, dian you shang jiao xin jian kai shi." in text-sm text-neutral-500. Single artboard at 1440x900. Match the Dashboard draft for visual identity exactly.

title: New Interview Form
prompt: Create or Edit interview form modal-style page. Same JobPulse identity. Page title: "xin jian mian shi" or "bian ji mian shi ji hui". Cancel plus primary indigo-700 "bao cun" button on the right. Form fields in 3 sections, default-open and clean: (1) BASIC: company name required (text input), position name required (text input) - required fields marked with a small red asterisk. (2) FIRST INTERVIEW: first interview time (uses the DateTimeInput component, showing a clean button "dian ji xuan ze ri qi shi jian" that opens a 10-min-interval Chinese calendar picker), format (dropdown: xian shang shi pin / xian xia / dian hua), location (single text input, e.g. "guang zhou hai zhu zhi tong guang chang"). (3) META in 2-col grid: contact or HR (text), source (dropdown: Boss zhi pin / la gou / nei tui / lie tou / gong si guan wang / qi ta), salary range (2-col: range dropdown 8-10K to 50K plus custom, plus months dropdown 12/13/14/15/16). Below: a single collapsible section "gao ji xuan xiang" (default closed) containing benefits (multi-select tag pills: wu xian yi jin etc plus other text area), work hours (dropdown: 9:00-18:00 etc plus custom), is weekend off (checkbox), JD link (text), JD text (textarea, monospace), notes (textarea). Form width: max-w-2xl, centered. Form labels: text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 tracking-wide uppercase mb-1.5. Inputs: bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm hover:border-neutral-400 focus:border-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-700/20. Single artboard at 1440x900. Match Dashboard identity exactly.

title: Opportunity Detail
prompt: Detail page for one job opportunity. Same JobPulse identity. Top: back link "fan hui lie biao" (text-sm text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-900) on the left, Edit (ghost) plus Delete (text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50) buttons on the right. Below: page header with opportunity title (text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-neutral-900, e.g. "zi jie tiao dong, hou duan kai fa gong cheng shi") and city (text-sm text-neutral-500). Right of header: status select (matching the chip style, border-neutral-300, shows current status with leading dot). Optional call-to-action card (only when status is offered or accepted AND final_salary or final_benefits is missing): bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-4 with text-indigo-800 text-sm "lu ru offer xiang qing" plus small indigo-700 "qu tian xie" link button. Then 4-column overview grid of cards (rounded-xl, p-4, shadow-xs, white bg) showing xin zi / gong shi / fu li / shuang xiu with small uppercase label (text-xs text-neutral-500 tracking-wide uppercase) plus value (text-sm font-medium text-neutral-900). If JD exists: section heading "gang wei JD" plus pre-formatted JD text in monospace on a card (rounded-xl, white bg, border-neutral-200, p-4). Then section heading "mian shi lun ci" plus "+ tian jia lun ci" primary indigo-700 button. Then a vertical stack of round cards (rounded-xl, white bg, border-neutral-200, p-4, shadow-xs): each shows round number plus type (ji shu yi mian / HR shai xuan) plus time plus format plus outcome indicator (leading dot in status color plus yi tong guo / wei tong guo / dai mian shi). On hover: border-indigo-700 plus shadow-sm. Under each round (if outcome is pending): "biao ji wei yi tong guo" plus "biao ji wei wei tong guo" text buttons in green-700 and red-700. Single artboard at 1440x1100. Match Dashboard identity exactly.
